findings.oracle: Drive real GhidraBridge.define_structure/create_function with a failing RPC double through the actual _execute_remote path; replace the _logger mock with structlog.testing.capture_logs and assert the exact ToolError message ('Define structure failed: Remote execution failed: simulated_remote_error'), the chained __cause__ (ToolError -> RuntimeError 'simulated_remote_error'), and the captured warning record fields (event, log_level=='warning', struct_name/address, error); plus not-connected paths asserting the ghidra_not_connected error record.

Added test_script_manager_save_uses_language_extension_on_disk: persist each language via the real ScriptManager.save_script path and assert the on-disk file's exact name/suffix/parent/content (oracle = conventional per-tool extension, independent of the production map). Added test_script_context_to_prompt_full_structure_exact_layout asserting the entire rendered prompt equals a hand-written expected multi-section string (section order, headers, 0xDEADBEEF formatting, strategy expansion, Frida API footer).

Drive the real Rust-backed HexDocument via HexEditorBridge over an 8-byte pattern; assert every bit of every byte at every offset equals the independent LSB-0 oracle ((byte>>i)&1) to catch off-by-one/endianness/offset bugs; assert get_bit determinism across 5 repeats; build a full byte by setting bits 0..7 (0x01..0x80) and reading bytes back; verify clear/idempotent set; double-toggle restores the byte; and bit_index in {8,9,-1,-8,16,64} consistently raises ValueError plus no-document RuntimeError.

Added TestParseFileLogEdgeCases and TestParseRegistryLogEdgeCases driving real malformed on-disk logs: unescaped pipe in path/key shifts remainder into optional fields (asserted exactly), colon-bearing Windows paths preserved, non-numeric/negative size collapses to None, operation-alias normalization (move->renamed, write->modified, unknown->modified), non-ASCII UTF-8 key/value round-trip, extra trailing field ignored, empty middle field collapses to None, and interleaved valid/malformed lines yield only well-formed records in original order.
